BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

2. When learning Site Preparation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation.

3. When learning Concreting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Concreting.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting.

4. When learning Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.

5. When learning Foundations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Foundations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Foundations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Foundations.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Foundations.

6. When learning Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.

7. When learning Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.

8. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

10. When learning Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.

11. When learning Introduction to Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Site Preparation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Isometric Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation.

3. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting.

4. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Foundations.

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

9. B — Never touch live wires with wet hands

10. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.

11. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.

12. A — Information and Communication Technology

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Isometric Drawing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Computer Aided Drawing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
